scope: Train refit replay, frozen-prior numeric residual learning, actual sequential Train comparison and separately registered exploratory original Dev. Controlled documents and responses only.

stability-trace.scope: Exact replay of preserved full-Train updates with new intermediate diagnostics. No candidate selection or Dev/Test inference.

plan.scope: Both conditions refit all 1204 Train states / 85 source families. Same initial weights and 40 epochs x 19 updates x 64 draws, same actual targets and optimizer. Capture fixed epochs from the completed source-held screen; do not reselect from full-Train or Dev scores. Preserve final heads, fixed selected heads, both optimizer states, every batch and epoch loss.

devPlan.scope: Frozen full-refit heads, all three seeds. Same original 60 generated Dev cases and 336 retail Dev conditions; evaluate all 16 channel-availability patterns and weight at 0, 0.1 and 0.2. No Test or frozen 27-source use.
devPlan.gates: Every balanced seed must worsen neither benchmark relative to its uniform refit and the retained parent: generated mean total and retail mean total on complete periods at all three response rates. No more false handoffs or requests for already resolved fields; no lower final parameter/state/evidence accuracy. Under retail no-dropout, retain all required requests, recoveries and handoffs. Public document metrics must not decrease. At least one actual mean total must strictly improve over the retained parent across all seeds; candidate remains fixed seed 42, not a post-hoc best seed.
devPlan.interpretation: Report terminal loss and request costs separately; controlled documents and responses do not establish organizational effectiveness. Retain unchanged model if any required gate fails.

residual.scope: Train-only numeric residual comparison with the same actual returns and saved batch draws. Frozen parent value head; no encoder or demand updates.

plan.scope: Preserve the frozen parent value function and learn a zero-initialized 94-to-128-to-2 numeric residual in logit space. Compare to the registered joint numeric/encoded head using identical cached states, return targets, observed-response sampling draws, optimizer settings and update counts. The design changes both the numeric route and which parameters are trainable; it is not a single-factor proof that Tanh saturation caused failure.
plan.innerGate: Same 68 fitting / 17 held Train families. Select the earliest strict best held family-balanced target loss within 40 epochs, then require every seed to improve on its prior balanced control with neither benchmark nor false handoffs worse. Parent encoder previously saw these Train sources; this is not independent generalization.
plan.refitGate: If every inner gate passes, start from the same parent plus the same seeded zero correction and refit all 1204 Train states at each fixed inner-selected epoch; preserve all 40 epochs and final weights. Reuse exact saved full-refit batch draws. On the former inner-held Train states require neither benchmark target loss nor false handoffs to worsen relative to the selected inner candidate. No epoch reselection from refit or Dev.
plan.nextStage: Only if inner and refit gates pass, compare actual full-refit policies on the original 514 Train episodes and four new shared response draws. All three seeds must worsen neither benchmark relative to both retained parent and matched full-refit control, have no more false handoffs or requests for resolved fields, and retain no-dropout required retail requests and recoveries. At least one actual total must improve over the retained parent in every seed. Seed 42 remains the candidate; do not choose a best seed.
plan.devGate: Only after sequential Train gates pass: freeze candidates and evaluate original 60 generated Dev and 336 retail Dev conditions with all 16 shared channel-availability patterns weighted at 0, 0.1, 0.2. Compare with retained parent and full-refit control; every seed must worsen neither benchmark total, final parameter/state/evidence accuracy, false handoffs, unnecessary requests, and public document metrics. Preserve retail no-dropout necessary requests and recoveries. At least one actual total must strictly improve over parent for every seed. No Test or frozen 27-source inference.

selected-sequential.scope: Separate registered comparison of preserved held-selected checkpoints versus their full refits and the retained parent on Train. Earlier refit-stability failure remains a failed study; no new weight fitting or epoch selection. Not independent organizational effectiveness.

registration.scope: A new checkpoint-selection comparison after the prior full-refit stability failure. Evaluate all three original held-selected residual checkpoints (epochs 12, 13, 13) unchanged, their three corresponding full refits, and the retained parent. No new fitting, alternative epoch or seed selection. The prior registered full-refit candidate remains rejected.
registration.sources: Original 514 Train episodes / 85 families: 360 generated, 154 retail. Four fresh shared channel-response draws per episode (retail dropout 0.1, generated original response model); one additional retail-only no-dropout draw for required-question/recovery checks. Seven policies x 2210 paths = 15470.
registration.gate: Each selected checkpoint must worsen neither generated nor retail total versus retained parent and its same-seed full refit, have no more false handoffs or resolved-field/unnecessary requests, and preserve no-dropout retail necessary requests, recovery and handoff rates. At least one actual total must improve over retained parent for every seed. Seed 42 remains the candidate. All three must pass before original Dev evaluation.
registration.devGate: If Train gates pass, use the same fixed checkpoints on original 60 generated Dev and 336 retail Dev conditions with all 16 shared response patterns weighted at 0, 0.1, 0.2. All three must worsen neither benchmark relative to retained parent and same-seed refit, retain final parameter/state/type/evidence accuracy, no additional false handoffs/unnecessary requests, retain no-dropout necessary requests/recoveries/handoffs and public document metrics. Require at least one actual total improvement over parent for every seed. No Test/frozen 27-source evaluation.

residual-dev.scope: Exploratory actual Dev validation registered after all six frozen heads improve actual Train outcomes versus the parent. Full-refit stability and selected-versus-refit proxy filters remain failed; this is a separate development comparison, not a retroactive pass. Primary fixed mode is full refit; held-selected heads are diagnostics. No new fitting or Test/holdout use.

registration.scope: Separate exploratory development validation motivated by disagreement between cached-state filters and actual sequential Train outcomes. All three full-refit policies improve actual Train total loss against the retained parent with no safety/request regression. Earlier full-refit stability filter failed for seed 44; selected-checkpoint comparison failed against the full refits for all seeds. Those failures remain failures; this run is not reported as a pass of either original protocol.
registration.selection: Use all six already frozen checkpoints (inner selected epochs 12/13/13 and their fixed full refits). No new fitting, seed selection or epoch selection from Dev. Full refit is fixed primary mode based on original intended model and better actual generated Train losses in all seeds; selected checkpoints are a diagnostic comparison, not fallback candidates if primary Dev fails.
registration.primaryDevCriteria: Every refit seed must worsen neither generated total nor retail expected total at missing-response rates 0, 0.1, 0.2 relative to retained parent; retain final parameter/state/type/evidence accuracy, no additional false handoffs or unnecessary/resolved-field requests, no-dropout retail necessary requests/recoveries/handoffs, and all public document metrics. At least one actual total must strictly improve for every seed. If primary fails, retain current model and do not adopt a diagnostic seed/mode after inspecting Dev.
registration.interpretation: Dev is development evidence after multiple transparent Train studies, not confirmatory evidence of organizational effectiveness. Preserve all negative protocols, raw outcomes, terminal/request decomposition and source/sample limitations. Exact retail financial loss remains five complete Dev periods / four sources / 35 conditions. Demand calibration and public extraction are not solved by a policy-head change.

limitations: Old refit and selected-versus-refit filters failed; subsequent Dev is separately registered exploratory development, not a retrospectively passed protocol.
Primary full refit/42 and all three required seeds were fixed before Dev; no fallback to the diagnostic selected mode.
Parent encoder had seen the Train families; source-held action-head selection is not independent generalization.
Exact retail losses use only five complete periods from four sources, giving 35 conditions.
Tanh saturation was observed, not isolated as a cause. The residual changes both input routing and trainable parameters.
Generated Dev is 60 cases from 12 families. Public extraction, demand calibration and the historical frozen Test threshold remain unresolved.
